map.按窗户尺寸、褶皱倍数与布料幅宽估算窗帘用料米数，考虑对花与边距损耗，帮助买布前核: Estimate curtain fabric metres from window size, fullness ratio and fabric width, allowing for pattern matching and hem loss so you can work out quantities before buying and avoid waste or shortfall.
map.每幅用料长 = 成品高 + 上下缝边 + 对花损耗: Fabric per panel = finished height + top and bottom hems + matching loss
map.客厅落地窗：输入窗宽与成品高度，选褶皱倍数 2.0、布料幅宽 1.4m，按「窗宽: Living room floor-to-ceiling window: enter the window width and finished height, pick a fullness ratio of 2.0 and a fabric width of 1.4m, and the total metres follow from "window width × fullness ÷ width rounded up × per-panel height + loss".
map.卧室遮光帘：拼接幅宽不足时需对花，额外加对花损耗；双层帘（纱+布）分别计料。: Bedroom blackout curtains: when the combined width falls short, patterns must be matched, so add matching loss; double-layer curtains (sheers plus fabric) are calculated separately.
map.罗马帘/卷帘：按「窗宽×窗高×倍数+上下卷边」估算，异形窗分块计。: Roman blinds / roller blinds: estimate from "window width × window height × fullness + top and bottom roll"; split irregular windows into panels.
map.整窗窗帘布料: Curtain fabric for the whole window
map.：示例：窗宽 3.0m、高 2.6m，褶皱倍数 2.0，布幅 1.4m，上下卷边:
: example: window 3.0 m wide and 2.6 m high, fullness 2.0, fabric width 1.4 m, total top and bottom roll 0.3 m.
• horizontal panels ≈ ceil(3.0×2.0 ÷ 1.4) = 5 panels
• per-panel height ≈ 2.6 + 0.3 = 2.9m
• total metres ≈ 5 × 2.9 = 14.5m (add 0.1–0.2m per panel for pattern matching)
map.褶皱倍数怎么选？: How is the fullness ratio chosen?
map.薄纱 1.5–1.8、棉麻 1.8–2.0、绒布/欧式 2.0–2.2；倍数越大: Sheers 1.5–1.8, cotton and linen 1.8–2.0, velvet / European style 2.0–2.2; a higher ratio drapes more but uses more fabric.
map.有循环花型的布料每幅需对齐花距，通常每幅加一个花距（约 0.1–0.3m），素色: Patterned fabric needs each panel aligned to the pattern repeat, usually adding one repeat per panel (about 0.1–0.3 m); plain colours can ignore this.
map.窗帘布多按米裁剪出售，一般不支持整退；建议先用本工具精算，留少量余量后再补。: Curtain fabric is generally sold cut to the metre and usually cannot be returned whole; price it with this tool first, then buy a little extra and top up later.
